title: World Cup Day 26: Belgium beat USA 4-1; Spain beat Portugal 1-0
excerpt: Group stage action from Seattle, WA, Arlington, TX on July 06 — 2 matches, no shortage of drama.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Belgium defeated the USA 4-1 in a dominant World Cup performance.
  • Spain edged Portugal 1-0 in a tightly contested match.
  • Both USA and Portugal are at risk of elimination with zero points.
  • Spain and Belgium are in strong positions with 3 points each.
  • Upcoming matches include Argentina vs Egypt and Switzerland vs Colombia.
Match Highlights: Belgium vs USA
›Belgium scored 4 goals against USA's 1.
›Belgium dominated possession and pressed high.
›USA's defense struggled against Belgium's intensity.
›This match marked a strong start for Belgium.

Day 26 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup delivered 2 matches and 6 goals on Monday, July 06. The tournament, spread across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, continued its group stage with action that will resonate in standings tables and living rooms alike — not least in the Indian-American households tuning in from cities that are, for once, hosting the spectacle rather than streaming it from half a world away.

Here is everything you need to know.

Portugal 0-1 Spain

*Group R16 · AT&T Stadium, Arlington, TX*

Spain snatched the win in a closely contested Group R16 match, edging Portugal 1-0 at AT&T Stadium. It was a game of slim margins and hard tackles, the kind of World Cup fixture where one moment of quality makes all the difference.

The result is a blow for Portugal but not a fatal one. With two group games remaining, there is time to recover — but the margin for error has narrowed.

> "The result is a blow for Portugal but not a fatal one."

AT&T Stadium in Dallas hosted the fixture, with DFW's booming desi community well represented in the crowd. North Texas has become one of the fastest-growing hubs for Indian-American families in recent years.

USA 1-4 Belgium

*Group R16 · Lumen Field, Seattle, WA*

Belgium produced the standout result of the day, hammering USA 4-1 at Lumen Field. It was a masterclass from the opening minutes, with Belgium pressing high, winning second balls, and punishing every defensive lapse. USA looked shell-shocked by the intensity.

![World Cup — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/fb/Kitzbuehel_slalom_ganslernhang_2010.jpg)

For Belgium, this is as good a World Cup start as they could have scripted. For USA, the question now is whether they can recover mentally — and on goal difference — in time for their remaining group fixtures.

What It Means for the Standings

In Group R16, Spain move to 3 points and put themselves in a strong position; Belgium move to 3 points and put themselves in a strong position; Portugal sit on zero points and will need results in their remaining fixtures; USA sit on zero points and will need results in their remaining fixtures.

Match Highlights: Spain vs Portugal
›Spain won 1-0 against Portugal in a close match.
›The match was held at AT&T Stadium in Arlington.
›Portugal faces pressure with two group games remaining.
›Spain's victory puts them in a strong position.

With 48 teams and a format that sends the top two from each group — plus the eight best third-placed sides — into the round of 32, the margins are tighter than they appear. Goal difference could prove decisive.

What's Next

Day 27 (Tuesday, July 07) brings 2 more group stage matches:

  • **Argentina vs Egypt** — Group R16 at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Atlanta, GA
  • **Switzerland vs Colombia** — Group R16 at BC Place, Vancouver
